name: Beginner · Full Body Foundation
description: 2-3x/week with a rest day between. Squat, hinge, push, pull and brace in one session. Stop 2 reps shy of failure and add load only once all sets hit the top of the range.

name: Beginner · Upper Body Basics
description: One push, one pull, then arms. 60-90s rest. Keep the dumbbells light enough that the last rep of every set is still clean.

name: Beginner · Leg Day Starter
description: Knee-dominant first, hip-dominant second, calves last. 60-90s rest. Expect soreness the first fortnight - keep the range of motion honest rather than chasing weight.

name: Beginner · Back Builder
description: Vertical pull, horizontal pull, then posterior chain. Use the assisted pull-up machine until you own 3 sets of 8, then move to bodyweight.

name: Beginner · Cardio Kickstart
description: Easy aerobic base plus light calisthenics. Treadmill and elliptical entries are minutes, not reps. Hold a conversational pace - you should be able to talk throughout.

name: Intermediate · Full Body Power
description: 3x/week. Barbell compounds first while you are fresh, accessories after. 2-3min rest on the big three, 90s on the rest.

name: Intermediate · Upper Body Strength
description: Heavy press and pull up front, hypertrophy work behind it. If you cannot get 8 clean pull-ups, use a band and keep the volume.

name: Intermediate · Leg Strength
description: Squat and hinge are the session; everything after is accessory. Add 2.5kg only when all 4 sets hit 8 reps with clean depth.

name: Intermediate · Back & Pull
description: Deadlift heavy and low-rep, then vertical and horizontal pulls. Brace hard and reset every deadlift rep from a dead stop.

name: Intermediate · Conditioning Circuit
description: Circuit style: move between exercises with minimal rest, then 90s between rounds. Scale the round count before you scale the reps.

name: Advanced · Full Body Performance
description: 4-6x/week split across sessions. Heavy 5x5 on the main lifts at 80-85%, 3min rest. Deload every 4th week by cutting the sets in half.

name: Advanced · Upper Body Hypertrophy
description: High volume, 60-90s rest. Take the final set of each accessory to within 1 rep of failure. Add weight to the chin-ups once you clear 10 clean reps.

name: Advanced · Leg Hypertrophy
description: Highest-volume session in the library - do not stack it the day before a heavy pull. Explosive work last so it never eats into the heavy squats.

name: Advanced · Back Mass
description: Heavy deadlift, then vertical and horizontal volume. Straps are fine once grip becomes the limiter - the back is the target, not the forearms.

name: Advanced · Metabolic Conditioning
description: 5 rounds, 60s rest between rounds only. Battling ropes and bear crawl entries are seconds. Cap it at 25 minutes - if you can go longer you are not working hard enough.
